name: Monthly options-expiry Friday: short the cash session
why: On the 3rd Friday dealers' expiring hedges come off and the open interest that pinned price disappears; the map shows the OPEX Friday RTH -17.6 bp vs +3.6 bp on an average session, negative in all three eras and 12 of 17 years. Small sample (~12 a year). Pre-registered; holdout 2025-01 on judged once.
